description: NUMo Nagoya Urban Mobility SUMO scenario provides the NUMo SUMO traffic scenario with road-volume and signal calibration. The provider is Toyota Motor Corporation. Geographical and temporal coverage: Toyota's Nagoya scenario uses Japan's fiscal-2021 road census and calibration on 1618 road segments. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The exact licence must be read in LICENSE.md. Calibration is developer-reported and was not rerun. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
